reviews.evidence: Correctly rejects blanket conversion to include_cached, identifies uncached caller-context helpers, explains passed page-dependent parameters and names shared index/recommendation components. Omits key layout details: landingpage inheritance/position, cached footer/cloud behavior and page-specific comments. Uses LaTeX arrows despite the plain-text-arrow instruction.
In Spanish, gives url as the site origin and baseurl as /blog, with valid YAML.

Correctly gives the GA4 gtag_id code, but falsely says a populated analytics_id may cause issues and should not be set. The documented behavior is that analytics_id is independent and both configured IDs load both snippets.

Correctly keeps ALGOLIA_API_KEY out of public configuration and its YAML places search_only_api_key under algolia. Contradictory prose says that key is a top-level sibling of search, which is the wrong nesting; the code is correct.

Places autothemer under chulapa-skin.vars, but the documented setting is chulapa-skin.autothemer alongside vars. The provided configuration therefore does not enable the requested feature. Also uses LaTeX arrows.
Correctly distinguishes loading the font stylesheet from assigning font-family-base and headings-font-family, with complete quoted YAML and a rebuild/check.

Correctly uses video_res=hqdefault for a missing maxresdefault preview and nolazy=true to remove click-to-load activation, while noting browser lazy loading remains. Correctly distinguishes metadata thumbnail_url from the preview.

Identifies the custom_head include, generated favicon assets and baseurl requirement. The opening says explicit links belong in configuration, which is imprecise, and it omits a concrete baseurl-aware link specimen and preservation of existing favicon links.

Correct provider setting, local build-time indexing, legacy max-word caveat and Lunr link. Omits preserving other search settings, checking/reusing or creating the matching search page/permalink, avoiding duplicate output/baseurl and a concrete result verification.

Falsely states Person is the default/fallback publisher type; documentation defaults to Organization and unsupported types fall back to Organization. The example also presents a replacement publisher mapping without instructing the reader to preserve existing fields.

limits: Ten independent observations of this deployed source do not establish general answer accuracy, repeatability, latency distributions or human usability. All requests returned HTTP 200; that is not itself evidence of correctness. No retries were made.
